{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify premises
assert 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].unique(), "'loyal' segment not found"
assert 'completed' in df['status'].unique(), "'completed' status not found"
assert (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum() == 0, "QA rows with revenue '999999.99' exist, but should not"

# Convert revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Print key counts
print(f'Number of loyal customers in data: {len(loyal_completed)}')
print(f'Number of completed orders from loyal customers: {len(loyal_completed)}')
print(f'Number of refunded orders among loyal customers: {(df["customer_segment"] == "loyal") & (df["status"] == "refunded")}.sum()')

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue}')

# Return mean_revenue for submission
mean_revenue"}
